look_here_first: Texas annual milkvetch in the Nuttallianus complex with 4–12 flowers per raceme, relatively broad leaflets, and long narrow glabrous pods.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Source row Astragalus pleianthus normalized to current Kew/FNA accepted Astragalus nuttallianus var. pleianthus; Hays-local source retained.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; exact target-zone county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Fabaceae/Astragalus: alternate pinnate leaves, papilionoid pea flowers, and legumes; fruit shape, inflation, hairiness, and curvature are especially useful for species ID.
best_field_traits: glabrous narrow pods about 13–24 mm long
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with broad A. nuttallianus, var. pleianthus is the Edwards Plateau/Texas form with more-flowered racemes, broader leaflets, and glabrous narrow pods.
